conviction_note: Honest zero: the guide gives the Q4 bar directly, the likely print (adj. EBITDA at or a little above the top of the implied $36.6-38.6m) is what a firm that has raised three times this year would be expected to deliver and roughly what the single-analyst $0.97 EPS already assumes, and the FY2027 guide, which is what actually decides this print, cannot be seen from outside before 16:30 ET, so there is nothing to size.
bar: Q4 FY2026 adjusted EBITDA implied by the company's FY2026 guide of $150-152m less 9M actual $113.4m (Q1+Q2 $75.9m per Q2 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1005731/000149315226009545/ex99-1.htm; Q3 $37.5m per https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/6/3/3306409/33173/en/idt-corporation-reports-third-quarter-fiscal-year-2026-results.html) = $36.6-38.6m, midpoint $37.6m. The EPS bar is $0.97 (Investing.com, one analyst, https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/idt-earnings-up-next-can-guidance-momentum-continue-into-q4-93CH-4920579) against $0.98 (GuruFocus, https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9099239/idt-corporation-idt-set-to-report-q4-earnings-amid-valuation-concerns). Scaling Q3's $0.94 at $37.5m, $0.97 needs roughly the top of the guided EBITDA range. print_vs_bar_pct is measured against the EBITDA midpoint.
positioning_check: Short interest 386,859 shares, 1.56% of shares outstanding (fintel/stockanalysis snippet, https://fintel.io/ss/us/idt, settlement date not visible; FINRA's 2026-09-24 publication covers 09-15), which is about 1.5 days to cover on 260,858 average daily volume. searched_and_found_nothing: Guide arithmetic: 9M adj. EBITDA $113.4m against the $150-152m guide implies Q4 at $36.6-38.6m, about flat on Q1-Q3's run rate of $37.9m / $38.0m / $37.5m. In FY25 Q4 beat the implied $30.7m by about 8.8% ($33.4m, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1005731/000149315225016018/ex99-1.htm) and the stock still fell 18.4%, on a $0.76 vs $0.91 EPS miss and flagged NRS churn (https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/stocks/IDT/pressreleases/35219591/idt-stock-slips-following-q4-earnings-despite-strong-segment-growth/). That is reaction history, not an unpriced fact.

Q3 FY26 call (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/06/04/idt-idt-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/): 'carrying real momentum into the close of our fiscal year'; NRS competition 'definitely affected the new sign-ups' was said publicly, so it is priced; no Q4 one-offs were flagged; AI is called accretive in FY27 but not quantified.

Company press releases since June (https://www.idt.net/category/press-releases/): eSIM launch 09-03, Uber Eats integration 08-11, BOSS Money #1 in FXC Intelligence's app ranking at 4.9/5 on 07-13, NRSInsights same-store sales +3.4% June, +3.3% July, -1.1% August. August is after the quarter and is a store-traffic proxy, not NRS revenue.

Remitly Q2 2026 (2026-08-05, https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/05/3339673/0/en/remitly-reports-record-second-quarter-results-and-raises-full-year-2026-outlook.html): send volume +27%, guide raised. This is a public read-through for the digital-remittance tailwind (the 1% tax on cash transfers). IDT already disclosed digital send volume +40% in Q3, and the stock has gone from about $57 in June to about $68, so it is priced.

Form 4s: routine small sales in June and July 2026 by the CFO (23,323 at $56.98), two EVPs and directors, at $55-63 (https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/IDT/form-4-idt-corp-insider-trading-activity-af01b7bf84e8.html). No cluster that points either way before the print.

Q3 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1005731/000143774926019975/idt20260430_10q.htm): Straight Path litigation resolved in IDT's favour (Delaware Supreme Court, 2025-12-03); first year as a full federal cash taxpayer, with a 9M effective tax rate of 24.4% and Q3 at 26.4%. A Q4 tax true-up could swing EPS either way; the direction is not knowable.

Midwest IDEAS presentation on 2026-08-26, after the quarter closed: webcast only, and I found no slides or commentary on FY27 (https://www.idt.net/idt-corporation-to-present-at-midwest-ideas-investor-conference/).

NRS or net2phone spin-off: net2phone's separation was deferred until markets improve, and there is no 2026 NRS spin signal (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/idt-highlights-growth-engines-delays-150155023.html).
baseline_tension: Nothing I found cuts against the baseline: the stock sits 3% off its 52-week high with a flat 20-day run-up and a thin, downside-paid skew, and the likely at-guide EBITDA print is already reflected; the move will be set by the FY2027 guide and by the quality of EPS, neither of which can be seen in advance.
